name: 77803 · Bryan, TX
findings: ZIP 77803 (Bryan) has 63 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77803 (Bryan) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
52% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 77803 (Bryan) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 57% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
